name: Greek Pork Chops with Zucchini, Tomatoes and Feta
note: Adjudicator KEEP upheld. Seared chops braised with zucchini, tomatoes, olives and feta — distinct from greek-pork-souvlaki-rice-bowls (grilled tenderloin over rice) and from every catalog creamy/cheesy/gravy/rice pork-chop build, and from accepted pork (thai curry shoulder, braised shoulder fennel-tomato, pulled-pork peppers, chile verde, chorizo/sausage dishes). Greek/Mediterranean widens the American/Tex-Mex-skewing catalog. Cross-protein watch: a Greek chicken/turkey zucchini-tomato-feta skillet in another lane would collide; none accepted, flagged for merge pass.
